address: 1F, The Middle House Residences, 366 Shimen Yi Road, Jingan, Shanghai, China Mainland
bio: In northeast Italy, a frasca, identifiable by a branch hung over its doorway, was a gathering place for sharing farm-style food. In stark contrast, this stylish hotel restaurant boasts a modern vibe and a menu focused on authentic Italian home-style favourites. The handmade pasta stands out, especially the al dente ravioli. Try their Pinsa Romana and meats roasted on the Josper grill. The wine list has a nice selection of Italian vintages....
